project_type: React 18 + TypeScript (strict) SPA with Vite bundler, Konva canvas, Zustand stores, Supabase backend
build_system: Vite with tsc for type-checking. npm scripts: build, test, typecheck, lint
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, vi.mock for supabase module mocking
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc --noEmit in frontend/. 2. Run tests: NODE_OPTIONS='' npx vitest run in frontend/. 3. Confirm all 228+ tests pass.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. NODE_OPTIONS must be cleared (NODE_OPTIONS='') when running npx/vitest due to sandbox preload. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters). Path alias @/ maps to src/. Zustand v5. Supabase queries via fromTable() helper. Tests mock @/lib/supabase module.
key_patterns: Stores: Zustand create() with State/Actions/Store types. Components: function components with data-testid attrs. Tests: vi.mock supabase, makeTemplate helpers, beforeEach reset. Existing TemplateStatus enum has DRAFT/ACTIVE/ARCHIVED (spec says RETIRED but code says ARCHIVED). Status badge colors follow pattern in TemplateCard.tsx. Store barrel export in stores/index.ts.
directory_structure: frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores with __tests__/ subfolder. frontend/src/components/ - UI components grouped by feature (ProjectCreation/, BomPanel/, etc) with __tests__/ subfolders. frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces. frontend/src/lib/ - Utilities (supabase.ts, autosave.ts, snapshotBuilder.ts). frontend/src/canvas/ - Konva canvas components.
